title: Exact Constrained Decoding for Sequence Models: Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2606.13850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hidden Markov models are foundational for sequential inference, yet conditioning on pathwise constraints such as precedence requirements, visitation cardinalities, or monotonic state progression can introduce long-range dependencies that require additional memory for dynamic programming. To deal with this, we present Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models (CHMMs), a framework that compiles each constraint into a finite-state controller tracking a sufficient finite history, after which standard forward--backward and Viterbi recursions on the augmented chain compute exact constrained posteriors and maximum a posteriori paths in discrete time and, through uniformization, maximum a posteriori augmented-state sequences at observation times in continuous time. translated_title: 序列模型的精确约束解码：控制器增强隐马尔可夫模型及更多
translated_abstract: 隐马尔可夫模型是序列推断的基础，然而在路径级约束（如先后顺序要求、访问基数或单调状态推进）上进行条件化时，可能引入需要额外动态规划内存的长程依赖。为解决这一问题，我们提出了控制器增强隐马尔可夫模型（CHMMs），这是一个将每个约束编译为追踪足够有限历史的有限状态控制器的框架。此后，在增广链上运行标准的向前-向后算法和Viterbi递推，即可在离散时间中计算精确的约束后验和最大后验（MAP）路径，并且通过均匀化方法，在连续时间的观测时刻计算增广状态序列的最大后验估计。我们建立了多项理论保证，同时为11个约束族提供了一套控制器编码目录，使该框架得以实际应用。在实验方面，我们评估了该类方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出控制器增强隐马尔可夫模型（CHMMs）框架，将路径级约束编译为有限状态控制器，借助增广链上的标准递推算法，在离散与连续时间中实现精确的约束后验计算与最大后验路径解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Controller-Augmented Hidden Markov Models (CHMMs), a framework that compiles pathwise constraints into finite-state controllers, enabling exact constrained posterior computation and maximum a posteriori decoding in both discrete and continuous time via standard recursions on the augmented chain.
